newsitem.title: UK: Siebe, Smiths Industries up after stg fall.
newsitem.headline: Siebe, Smiths Industries up after stg fall.

text.p: Shares in engineering firms Siebe and Smiths Industries climbed on Thursday after a fall in sterling allowed them to recover some of the ground they lost in recent weeks due to the pound's strength, dealers said.
By 1045 GMT, Siebe was 25p firmer at 1009 and Smiths Industries was up 20p at 775. British Steel was 3-1/4p higher at 152-1/4.
All three firms have been battered by downgrades since the start of the year as analysts adjusted their figures to take into account the impact of a strong pound.
"They are currency-sensitive stocks and sterling's fall overnight benefited them," one market-maker said.
